label: Heating & air conditioning
about: Boiler, heating and air conditioning installation, servicing and repairs.
service_area: City centre and surrounding areas (up to 25 km)
booking_question: What do you need? (e.g. boiler service, no heating, AC not cooling) Include your address or area.

faqs.q: My heating isn't working | no heating | radiators cold | boiler not working
faqs.a: First check the boiler has power, the thermostat is turned up, and the pressure gauge is between 1 and 1.5 bar. If it shows an error code, note it down. If it still won't work, book a repair and we'll come out.

faqs.q: My AC is not cooling | air conditioning blowing warm air | aircon not working
faqs.a: Check the remote is on 'cool' mode and the filters aren't clogged. If it still blows warm air, it may need a service or a gas recharge: book a visit.

faqs.q: How often should I service my boiler? | annual service
faqs.a: Once a year, ideally before winter. It keeps it safe and efficient and keeps the warranty valid.

faqs.q: Do you give free quotes? | do you charge for quotes | free estimate
faqs.a: Yes, installation quotes are free. We'll visit, look at your home and give you a fixed price.

faqs.q: Are you gas certified? | qualified | licensed | insured
faqs.a: Yes, our engineers are gas certified and we're fully insured.

faqs.q: Do you do emergency call-outs? | out of hours | can you come tonight
faqs.a: Yes, for no heating or hot water in winter and for gas issues. Call us and we'll come as soon as possible.

emergencies.keywords: smell gas | gas smell | gas leak | huele a gas | fuga de gas
emergencies.message: If you smell gas: don't switch anything on or off, no flames or smoking. Open doors and windows, turn off the gas at the meter if you can do it safely, then leave the building and call the gas emergency line or your local emergency number from outside.

emergencies.keywords: carbon monoxide | co alarm | monoxide alarm | monoxido
emergencies.message: If your carbon monoxide alarm is going off or people feel dizzy, sick or sleepy: get everyone out into fresh air now, leave the door open, and call your local emergency number. Don't go back in until it's been checked.
